title: real worktree + friction-log checks for cvg session pre-stop
task_body: cvg session pre-stop should refuse to end a session that left worktrees without an open PR or friction-log entries pointing at unfinished work. Add real checks behind a session_checks module so each gate stands alone.
rationale: Historically-failed retrieval case: "pre-stop" is CLI jargon; the implementation lives in the extracted convergio-cli-session crate. pre_stop + pre_stop_run orchestrate; checks/* holds per-check logic; session.rs wires the subcommand.
